description: This file defines the TimesheetSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching timesheets within the OrangeHRM time management plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for date range and employee number, along with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: TimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating timesheet search filter parameters such as date range and employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number for which timesheets are being searched.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for timesheet search.
